crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
translations.bsb: And the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time,
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah called unto Abraham a second time out of heaven,
